build_DiHT_model: build a DiHT vision-language model with custom vision and text config dataclasses
encode_image_with_visual_transformer: encode an image tensor through the VisualTransformer to get normalized vision features
encode_text_with_transformer: encode text tokens through the text transformer and pool representations using max token id
run_DiHT_forward: run the DiHT model forward pass with image and text inputs to get paired features and logit scale
set_grad_checkpointing: enable gradient checkpointing on both the visual and text transformer to reduce memory usage
